## HEAD

*The mission's live operator-shape, captured before IDENTIFY hardens it into a tractable gap statement.*

fragments.rationale: A bare section marker naming this block as the mission's HEAD — the live operator-shape section, distinct from the hardened gap statement IDENTIFY will produce. It carries no demand of its own; it frames how everything under it must be read.

fragments.text: *The mission's live operator-shape, captured before IDENTIFY hardens it into a tractable gap statement.*
fragments.target: the epistemic status of the HEAD section
fragments.rationale: An italic gloss fixing the evidential standing of the section: this is the operator's live voice, captured upstream of the IDENTIFY phase, before that process hardens it into a tractable gap statement. Two moves in one: capture the operator turn as a processable observation, and observe the authority itself rather than the later stand-in. It asserts provenance and timing, not that any desired outcome has happened.

pattern_refs.rationale: The sentence performs exactly this capture: the mission's operator-shape is taken as a first-class observation with its wording preserved, before automation consumes it — the turn is the grounded material, not a summary of it.

Capturing the shape *before IDENTIFY hardens it* is the observe-the-authority discipline: the live operator voice is the thing the later gap statement is about, and the HEAD pins that authority down so the hardened statement cannot silently become the stand-in for it.

pattern_rejections.reason: That pattern puts a *formal, enforced* model upstream; the HEAD is deliberately pre-formal — its whole point is to exist before the tractable statement exists, so there is no coupled model to cite yet.
pattern_rejections.query: preserve the live shape of intent upstream of formalization

pattern_rejections.reason: Shape-first governs what IDENTIFY should do once it starts (generalise a candidate into a protocol family before MAP); this sentence is about capture *prior* to IDENTIFY, not about the generalisation move inside it.
pattern_rejections.query: capture the raw operator voice before process hardens it into a formal statement
